delivery_decision.increment: Correct I4's C2 violation and complete the ordinary one-team, one-week path from availability intake through Coverage Table to download of the same selected draft.
delivery_decision.classification: realization_refactor with local_repair: the accepted contracts and selected composition are sufficient; the localized implementation mismatch does not require changing C2 or reopening Product meaning.
delivery_decision.rationale: This establishes the smallest runnable delivery thread, exercises the currently unresolved connections, and preserves useful P7/X4 evidence. Prioritize focused boundary and path checks, with the small table-recognition probe available now. Expand qualification to refusal, failure recovery and reopening after the path exists; schedule substantial user acceptance near release.
delivery_decision.boundary: Work selection and handoff preparation are complete. Construction, user contact, release qualification and acceptance have not occurred.

evidence_disposition.E1: Reuse the satisfied independent evaluation for unchanged P7 under C2 over its declared planner laws and input domain. It does not establish adapter conformance, new connections, the complete path or user acceptance.
evidence_disposition.E2: Reuse the satisfied X4/D2 evaluation for a supplied draft. It does not establish the Coverage Table connection, download-failure behavior or the complete path. Independence is not stipulated.
evidence_disposition.E3: Retain as historical I3/C1 evidence. It cannot support I4/C2, and the localized final-day mismatch is contrary evidence for current reliance.
evidence_disposition.E4: Retain the exact historical complete-path success for I3/P6/X3 under C1. It does not qualify the current composition.
evidence_disposition.continuity: Actor/session change alone does not invalidate evidence. Preserve applicable results and original owner rulings; reassess affected claims and their dependents when material subjects, contracts, domains, configurations, oracles or evidence change. Independent assessment still requires the assessor's sufficiently acquired evidence and judgment.

steps.observation: Under the existing supervised-probe permission, the current Coverage Table can be shown now to a coordinator to observe whether an unfilled period is recognized before deciding to download. Record the exact view, scenario, user capability, observed interpretation and uncertainty without coaching.
steps.limit: This is a targeted recognition probe, not complete-path acceptance. It need not delay the authorized adapter repair and wiring. No probe was conducted here.

steps.observation: The prepared Worker first retains the localized I4/C2 counterexample, checks the repaired half-open interval law with a small independent oracle, and exercises the actual intake-to-planner exchange.
steps.limit: Unit evidence establishes the module-owned conversion law; integration evidence establishes the exercised participant contract.

steps.observation: Exercise the connected supported path with legal availability that produces both assignments and an actual gap. Observe all selected participants, the table distinction, selected-draft identity, and equality of downloaded assignments and unfilled periods under D2.
steps.limit: Directly supplied planner/exporter inputs cannot establish this path. Preserve the passing case as focused regression evidence; its success covers only exercised conditions.

steps.observation: Extend assembled-path qualification with malformed-availability refusal, a controlled download failure that preserves a usable selected draft, and reopening that draft without changing its assignments or gaps. Use the supported reopening route, excluding incidental process state where durability requires it. Exercise material boundary, failure and recovery combinations and retain focused regressions.
steps.limit: These remain unobserved release obligations. A failing case returns to its supported causal locus; it does not automatically authorize broader scope.

steps.observation: When the bounded capability is sufficiently complete near release, conduct substantial user acceptance through supported surfaces and obtain applicable independent assessment of the exact candidate, including relevant implementation and proof semantics.
steps.limit: Worker self-review, E1's planner-only independence, a successful join or a successful early probe cannot supply the required assessment of the release.

steps.observation: Present the exact candidate and its applicable evidence for the reserved Product/release-owner judgment.
steps.limit: Acceptance requires every mandatory applicable condition to be satisfied and conflicts or insufficient evidence resolved. Missing results remain open; neither aggregate green status nor the occurrence of review closes them.

qualification_sequence.revisit_rule: Revisit settled construction decisions when material counterevidence or changed subject/basis invalidates them. A failed recognition probe first pressures the current UI realization under the existing visibility requirement. Re-enter Product, requirements, contracts or accepted design only when the selected desired outcome changes or supported assessment establishes that their governing relation must change. Repeated cross-cutting surprises justify diagnosis of the smallest affected design boundary. Preserve unaffected evidence and unrelated authorized progress.

handoff_sections.label: Selected reference frames
handoff_sections.text:
Each URI below is an exact source route; purposes are scoped by this request. These are evaluation contexts, not additional actor activations.
Executive: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-executive-frame; select the increment, preserve authority and evidence applicability, and consume the return. Delivery sequencing: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#steel-thread-delivery.
Worker: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-worker-frame; construct and self-review the bounded path under the inherited operation grant.
Unit: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-unit-test-frame; evaluate the adapter's C2 conversion law and reuse unchanged module-law results.
Integration: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-integration-frame; evaluate actual intake/adapter/planner, planner/table and selected-draft/exporter exchanges, preserving participant and contract identities.
End to end: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-end-to-end-frame; witness availability intake through download on the actual assembled path.
User acceptance: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-user-acceptance-frame; distinguish the early table-recognition probe from later complete-capability user evidence; neither grants acceptance authority.
Reviewer: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-reviewer-frame; retain required independent exact-subject assessment at release, outside this Worker activation.
Owner: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/STDO_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASELINE.md#derived-generic-specialist-frame-set, Owner row; preserve the task owner's Product meaning, C2/D2 authority and grant limits. The Worker does not acquire those decisions.

handoff_sections.label: Outcome and construction
handoff_sections.text: Deliver the smallest ordinary path for one team and one week: availability intake -> interval adapter -> roster planner -> Coverage Table -> draft download. Classify this as realization_refactor and local_repair of implementation nonconformance under sufficient accepted contracts. Correct I4's inclusion of the final day using the already-settled C2 displayed-date conversion; an interval's end is excluded. Keep P7's C2 meaning and X4's D2 supplied-draft behavior, completing their selected-path wiring. The table must distinguish assigned and unfilled periods; missing availability stays missing. Pass the same selected draft to download, preserving all assignments and gaps. Multi-team planning and recurring schedules remain outside this increment. No new semantic or architectural decision is established by the stipulated defect.

handoff_sections.label: Focused qualification for this increment
handoff_sections.text: First retain the localized I4/C2 counterexample and demonstrate its repair with a small module-law check whose oracle derives from C2: for a legal nonempty interval [a,b), include its admitted interior and exclude b, including a boundary within the selected week. Exercise the actual intake-to-P7 exchange to detect an extra final day or double conversion. Then use legal one-team/week availability producing both assignments and a real gap. Through supported entry, submit it, request the draft, inspect the table, select that draft and download it. Retain actual exchanges across each seam, selected-draft identity and content, visible assigned/unfilled distinction, and downloaded assignments/gaps compared under D2 to the owner-issued selected draft. Directly injected planner/exporter inputs remain boundary-only evidence. Whole-path closure requires causal-path evidence as well as output agreement, with no private entry, invented availability, hidden regeneration or bypass of the selected participants. Preserve these focused deterministic checks as regression evidence; do not repeat unchanged component suites merely to increase test volume.

handoff_sections.label: Evidence reuse
handoff_sections.text: Use task.md#evidence-available-for-reuse as the retained record route. E1 remains satisfied independent evidence for unchanged P7 under C2 over its declared planner laws and domain. E2 remains satisfied evidence for unchanged X4 under D2 for a supplied draft; its independence is not stipulated. Neither covers the new wiring, complete current path, failure recovery or user acceptance. E3 is historical I3/C1 evidence and cannot support I4/C2; the localized mismatch is contrary current evidence. E4 remains a historical success for I3/P6/X3 under C1 and cannot qualify the current composition. Actor/session change alone invalidates none of these records. Recheck applicability and invalidate only affected claims and dependent results when their subject, basis, domain, oracle, configuration or evidence materially changes.

handoff_sections.label: Qualification frontier
handoff_sections.text: The ordinary-path increment does not close the release. A separately supervised, already-permitted small probe can use the current table now to observe whether a coordinator recognizes an unfilled period before choosing download; do not contact users under this request. After the connected path exists, select focused assembled-path cases for malformed-availability refusal, a failed download leaving the same draft usable, and reopening the selected draft unchanged. Exercise relevant failure/recovery seam combinations and retain focused regressions. Schedule substantial supported-surface user acceptance when the bounded capability is sufficiently complete near release, followed by the applicable independent assessment and reserved owner acceptance. Passing the first path or probe does not waive these obligations.

handoff_sections.label: Stop and source re-entry
handoff_sections.text: Return implementation defects for local repair while C2, D2 and accepted Product meaning remain sufficient. Stop the affected action for a missing or mismatched grant/checkpoint/participant binding, material evidence invalidation, or an unresolved relation outside this cone. Re-enter the actual owner only if an explicitly changed desired outcome or supported counterevidence requires changed Product meaning, requirements, contracts or accepted design. Repeated cross-cutting surprises warrant diagnosis of the affected design boundary; they do not authorize repeated unbounded repairs. Governing routes: stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment and stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md#proportional-disposition; stdo://releases/v2.5.0-rc.6/standards/DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md#proportional-design-sequencing. Preserve valid independent evidence and original owner rulings. Mere role changes, test counts or unrelated future features do not reopen settled decisions.

handoff_sections.label: Required return
handoff_sections.text: Return once to Executive with the exact construction subject and checkpoint, changed relations and paths, preserved contracts, actual commands and observations, case inputs and law-derived oracles, evidence routes, failed or unexercised cases, residuals and invalidators. Bind a Reference Frame Method result and exactly one Worker result: satisfied/candidate_ready for the declared increment, falsified/refused, indeterminate/incomplete, or out_of_frame or invalid_basis/re_entry_requested. Candidate readiness requires the focused increment obligations to pass; release obligations remain explicit residuals. Candidate_ready is not release acceptance, and self-review is not independent assessment. Missing activation predicates produce activation_refusal before work, not an invented Worker result. Stop after returning; do not activate a Reviewer or continue into another increment.
